title: Emit valid SARIF URIs for AL code analysis paths containing spaces
summary: ProcessALCodeAnalysisLogs now properly URI-encodes file paths with spaces in SARIF output to comply with URI standards and prevent upload warnings.
key_points: Added ConvertTo-SarifArtifactUri function to encode path segments while preserving forward slashes
Spaces in file paths are converted to %20 in SARIF artifact URIs
De-duplication logic still uses raw path names, ensuring semantics are unchanged
Eliminates thousands of 'not a valid URI' warnings from SARIF uploads
